card.title: Lost and Found - Key to the City

metadata.description: Printable Puzzles Needed! In this mystery-filled audio game, kids become junior detectives solving the case of the missing Key to the City! With help from a quirky robot named T.A.B.S., players follow clues through book chapters, solve puzzles, and uncover rhyming riddles to find the final hidden key. Designed for ages 8–12 (or younger with help), this adventure combines listening, reading, and hands-on printable games. Grown-ups, be sure to download the printable puzzles!
